proposal.scope: Simulates the disclosed 18-member SQLite family (put mode x trigger x channel) and keeps candidates consistent with all calibration receipts; answers only when all surviving candidates agree.
proposal.lesson: The receipts pin put mode to INSERT OR IGNORE (repeated puts on same key yield channel 2 for three puts, and committed_sum stays 1), no AFTER INSERT trigger (channel equals direct changes), and channel = main changes() (last statement count, not cumulative).
